pkgmetadata.longdescription: Selenium IDE is a record-and-playback tool for authoring Selenium WebDriver test scripts without writing code by hand: it records a browsing session as a reusable ".side" project and can export it to WebDriver code in several languages. Distributed upstream only as an Electron AppImage; there has been no new upstream release since this package's version (mid-2024), so the bundled Chromium/Electron runtime carries whatever CVEs were fixed upstream since then.
